name: On Record Credits
author: kellybransford

sections.description:
On Record Credits lets you manage and display your production credits directly from the WordPress dashboard. Add credits, assign album artwork from your Media Library, and display them in a beautiful accordion layout using the [on_record_credits] shortcode.

Features:
* Credits custom post type with artist, song title, role, and album artwork
* Interactive accordion display
* Full color customization — background, text, accent, and border colors
* Custom section heading
* Order control via page attributes
* Mobile responsive
* Works with Elementor, Gutenberg, and any page builder via shortcode

Usage:
1. Go to On Record Credits → Add New Credit
2. Fill in the artist name, song title, role, and optionally pick album artwork
3. Add [on_record_credits] shortcode to any page

External Services

This plugin does not connect to any external services. All data is stored locally in your WordPress database.

Google Fonts are loaded from fonts.googleapis.com for the Cormorant Garamond and Inconsolata typefaces. This is a standard Google service. No personal data is transmitted. See Google’s privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy and terms of service: https://policies.google.com/terms.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/on-record-credits
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress
  3. Go to On Record Credits → Add New Credit to add your first credit
  4. Go to On Record Credits → Settings to customize colors and heading
  5. Add [on_record_credits] to any page or Elementor Shortcode widget
sections.faq:
What shortcode do I use?

Add [on_record_credits] to any page, post, or Elementor Shortcode widget.

Can I customize the colors?

Yes — go to On Record Credits → Settings to change the background, text, accent, and border colors.

How do I control the order credits appear?

Open any credit and use the Order field in the Page Attributes box. Lower numbers appear first.
